title: StaffX
description: StaffX is a staff utilities plugin to make your moderating easier on your server
body:
# StaffX | Ultimate Staff Utilities
![StaffX Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71a7e360658dc824907b932562a88f579605fbfb.png)
As of current release **StaffX** is still in Development!
### Vanish Features
- No Item Pickup
- Staff Notifications
- Auto Disabled on leave
- Disabled chat
- "You are currently VANISHED" actionbar
- Visible to staff
- Hidden from TAB
### Freeze Features
- No item Pickup
- No item Drop
- No damage while frozen
- Cannot send Chat Messages
- Cannot Use Commands
- Cannot Move
- Cannot interact (blocks, items, food, enderpearls etc)
- Cannot Break Blocks
- Cannot Place Blocks
- Cannot Jump
- "You are currently FROZEN" actionbar
### Staff Chat Features
- access to hide staff chat
- access to toggle staff chat
- Access to link staff chat with discordSRV
### Plugin Features
- Help Command
- Author Command
- Reload Command
- Custom Prefix in config.yml

![StaffX Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ba874ae0aee5a7ced31356ba9fc1373f5a1a083.png)
```
/vanish | Lets staff go into vanish mode
```
```
/v | Lets staff go into vanish mode
```
```
/staffx help | Sends A Help Message
```
```
/staffx author | Sends info about the plugin's Author
```
```
/staffx reload | Reloads the StaffX plugin
```
```
/freeze <player> | Freezes the selected player
```
```
/tpo <player> | Lets you tp to offline players
```
```
/tpoffline <player> | Lets you tp to offline players
```
```
/seeender <player> | Lets you see that players ender chest
```
```
/enderchest <player> | Lets you see that players ender chest
```
```
/seeinv <player> | Lets you see that players inventory
```
```
/sc <message> | Lets you send messages in staff chat
```
```
/sc | Lets you toggle staff chat
```
```
/scmute | Lets you disable seeing staff chat
```
![StaffX Permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8333a9bb6f295a9af0e6901781dc9656a61475df.png)

- **staffx.*** Everyone with this permission has access to all StaffX permissions
- **staffx.reload** lets everyone with this permission use /staffx reload
- **staffx.vanish** lets everyone with this permission use /vanish
- **staffx.vanish.notify** Annouces to all players with this permission that you are vanished
- **staffx.vanish.see** Lets all players with this permission see vanished players
- **staffx.freeze** Lets all players with this permission Freeze players
- **staffx.invsee.use** Lets you see a players inventory 
- **staffx.seeender.use** Lets you see a players enderchest
- **staffx.tpo.use** Lets you teleport to a offline player
- **staffx.staffchat.use** Lets you send messages in SC
- **staffx.staffchat.mute** Lets you hide messages in SC
